# Fighting the Remade
## Limbs
Every Remade is built of limbs. The torso takes only a fraction of a hit, so shooting the body barely works. Take the limbs off.
- Slashing and piercing sever a limb easily. Blunt and heat sever it poorly. - Aim at a limb with the target selector. Unaimed hits land on a random one. - Legs give speed, arms give melee damage, the head gives sight and voice. A limb that comes off also costs the Remade a chunk of its health. - A Remade with no legs crawls. With no arms it can barely hurt anyone.
## Fire
Fire kills corruption. Set it alight with a flamethrower, a welder or an explosion.
- Corruption that burns away leaves the tile [bold]scorched[/bold] for about 10 minutes. Nothing grows back on a scorched tile until that runs out. - Remade take extra from heat. - A hunter that was burned does not get back up.
## Stopping the dead getting up
A dead body on corruption turns after 90 seconds. Move it off the corruption, burn it, or take the head. A body with no head never turns.
[bold]Necrotoxin[/bold] works too. A body with at least one unit of it in the blood never turns. Inject a corpse with a necrotoxin pen and it stays down.
## Necrotoxin
A thick brown poison. It is hard on the Remade and mild on the living.
- Make it in a chemical reactor: one part mercury, one part sulfur and one part ammonia make three parts necrotoxin. - A Remade with it in the blood takes poison damage every second, more with more in it, until it clears. A full pen is close to a dead slasher on its own. - Splashed or sprayed on a Remade it burns where it lands. - A living crewman only takes a little poison from it. It still hurts. Don't inject yourself.
## The plasma cutter
A short arc of plasma, made for hull plating. It takes limbs off the Remade in two or three shots on a limb.
- Print it in an autolathe: steel, glass, plasma and plastic. - It reaches 7 tiles and holds about 40 shots. Recharge it in a wall charger. - The arc also burns corruption away. - It does nothing to the Prime. See [textlink="Ending an outbreak" link="WFRemadeEnding"].
